answer: The defence rests on transcript hash with university attestation: a transcript whose hash matches the university record. Forging 345 of these means fabricating 345 separate authority-backed records, and each one must survive a live registry check. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The reef check runs in the open: 345 fakes pay the full price 345 times, one honest agent pays once, and the walnut trail in the ledger makes the trellis cost visible to everyone.
